leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript factory function that generates typed test utilities
Configure generic type parameters to enforce input and output type safety
Construct validation logic that leverages TypeScript's type system at runtime
Apply conditional types to create flexible utility behaviors based on input
Integrate error handling with typed error messages for invalid inputs
Manipulate function signatures to ensure proper type inference in test scenarios
Initialize a test suite using the factory to validate different data types
